en.r: Capitol Reef National Park is a national park in Utah, United States. It covers 979 km² and has been protected since 1971. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.r: Zion National Park is a national park in Utah, United States. It covers 596 km² and has been protected since 1919. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.

en.r: Bryce Canyon National Park is a national park in Utah, United States. It covers 145 km² and has been protected since 1928. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Mormon pioneers arrived in the 1850s, and the name comes from Ebenezer Bryce, who homesteaded here in 1874. It became a national monument in 1923 and a national park in 1928.
en.ff: It is not a canyon but a series of natural amphitheaters on the eastern edge of the Paunsaugunt Plateau, filled with hoodoos, rock spires carved by frost and erosion in red, orange and white. The rim sits at 2,400–2,700 m. It has some of the darkest skies in the US, and Utah prairie dogs live in its meadows.
